words.ex: The roads were difficult to drive on because they were covered in slushy snow.
words.ex_cn: 由于道路上覆盖着半融化的雪，驾驶变得困难。
words.en: Slushy is used to describe something that is a mixture of snow and water, often dirty and partially melted, or something that resembles this mixture in texture or appearance.

words.tr: n. 油条（西班牙和拉丁美洲的一种甜点）
words.ex: I had a churro with chocolate sauce for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 我早餐吃了一个蘸巧克力酱的油条。
words.en: A churro is a fried-dough pastry—predominantly choux—based snack. Churros are popular in Spain and Latin America.

words.tr:
n. 小困难或障碍；划破处；钩丝处
v. 被钩住；划破；抢先获得
words.ex: He found a snag in the plan.
words.ex_cn: 他在计划中发现了一个问题。
words.en: A snag is a small problem or difficulty that you did not expect.

words.ex: He placed the cups on a tray.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子放在一个托盘上。
words.en: A tray is a flat container, usually made of wood, plastic, or metal, with raised edges, used for carrying things such as food or drinks.

words.ex: The child played with a wooden cube.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩了一个木制立方体。
words.en: A cube is a solid object with six square faces which are all the same size.

words.tr:
n. 闪耀；闪烁；小发光物
v. 闪耀；闪亮；流露（感情）
words.ex: The glitter of the stars lit up the night sky.
words.ex_cn: 星星的闪耀照亮了夜空。
words.en: If something glitters, light comes from or is reflected off different parts of it.

words.tr:
n. 大炮；火炮
v. 猛撞；碰撞
words.ex: The soldiers fired the cannon at the enemy.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们向敌人开炮。
words.en: A cannon is a large, heavy piece of artillery which was used in wars to fire heavy metal balls or shells.

words.tr:
n. 打巴掌
v. 用巴掌打
adv. 恰好地；猛地
words.ex: He gave the table a loud smack.
words.ex_cn: 他重重地拍了一下桌子。
words.en: If you smack someone or something, you hit them with your open hand. It can also refer to the sound made by a quick, sharp blow or the taste or flavor of something.

words.tr: n. 内部通话系统（或设备）； 对讲机
words.ex: He pressed the intercom to ask for help.
words.ex_cn: 他按了对讲机来寻求帮助。
words.en: An intercom is a communication system that allows people in different parts of a building or vehicle to speak to each other.

words.tr: n. <非正式>连帽衫，带帽夹克（=hoody）
words.ex: He wore a black hoodie and jeans.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件黑色连帽衫和牛仔裤。
words.en: A hoodie is a type of casual jacket with a hood.

words.tr: adj. 可耻的； 丢脸的；令人反感的；诽谤性的
words.ex: The scandalous news shocked everyone.
words.ex_cn: 这则丑闻让每个人都震惊了。
words.en: If you describe something as scandalous, you are shocked that it is considered acceptable or that it happens.

words.tr: n. 磅数；按磅计算的费用
words.ex: The shop charges a small poundage for each transaction.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店对每笔交易收取少量手续费。
words.en: Poundage refers to a charge or rate based on weight in pounds, or the amount of something measured in pounds.

words.tr: adj. 最愚蠢的；最迟钝的
words.ex: He gave the dumbest answer in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上给出了最愚蠢的答案。
words.en: The superlative form of 'dumb,' meaning the least intelligent or most foolish.

words.tr: n. 主要演员；头条新闻；顶篷
words.ex: She became the headliner of the show after years of hard work.
words.ex_cn: 经过多年的努力，她成为了节目的头牌人物。
words.en: A headliner is the main performer or act in a show, concert, or event, often the one that attracts the most attention or audience.

words.tr: adj. 着迷的；（受…）困扰的； v. “obsess”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is obsessed with video games.
words.ex_cn: 他着迷于电子游戏。
words.en: If someone is obsessed with a person or thing, they keep thinking about them and find it difficult to think about anything else.

words.tr: adj. 司法的；法庭的；审判的；
words.ex: The judicial system protects people's rights.
words.ex_cn: 司法系统保护人民的权利。
words.en: Judicial means relating to the legal system and to judgments made in a court of law.

words.ex: His activism helped change the law.
words.ex_cn: 他的行动主义帮助改变了法律。
words.en: Activism is the policy or action of using vigorous campaigning to bring about political or social change.

words.tr: n. 腹部疼痛；胃痛（非正式用语）
words.ex: He is bellyaching about the long wait.
words.ex_cn: 他正在抱怨漫长的等待。
words.en: To complain persistently and whiningly about trivial matters.

words.ex: He is a conservative man who likes old traditions.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个喜欢古老传统的保守男子。
words.en: A conservative person or group is one that does not like changes or new ideas, especially in politics or religion.

words.ex: He is a hypocrite because he says he loves peace but fights often.
words.ex_cn: 他是个伪君子，因为他声称热爱和平，却经常打架。
words.en: A hypocrite is someone who pretends to have certain beliefs or opinions that they do not really have, especially in order to deceive people.

words.ex: NASA is an acronym for National Aeronautics and Space Administration.
words.ex_cn: NASA 是美国国家航空航天局的缩写。
words.en: An acronym is a word formed from the initial letters of the words in a phrase, especially when this is used as a name.

words.tr:
v. 猛冲；急奔；“dash”的现在分词
adj. 时髦的；冲劲足的
words.ex: He was dashing across the street when the car stopped.
words.ex_cn: 他正猛冲过马路时，车停了下来。
words.en: Someone who is dashing is very stylish and attractive.

words.ex: The sculptor carved a statue from stone.
words.ex_cn: 这位雕刻家从石头中雕刻出一座雕像。
words.en: A sculptor is an artist who creates sculptures.

words.tr: adj. 滑行的；流畅的；滑顺的; v. 滑翔；消逝；溜走（glide 的 ing 形式）
words.ex: The gliding bird moved silently across the sky.
words.ex_cn: 那只滑行的鸟静静地飞过天空。
words.en: The activity of flying a glider.

words.tr: n. 编舞艺术；舞蹈编排；
words.ex: The dancer praised the choreography of the ballet.
words.ex_cn: 这位舞者称赞了这部芭蕾舞的编舞艺术。
words.en: Choreography is the art of designing sequences of movements in which motion, form, or both are specified. Choreography may also refer to the design itself. A choreographer is one who creates choreographies by practicing the art of choreography.

words.tr:
adj. 断掉的；被当场逮到的
v. 打碎；搜捕；“bust”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: The company went busted after the scandal.
words.ex_cn: 丑闻发生后，公司破产了。
words.en: If someone is busted, the police arrest them. If a company goes bust, it loses so much money that it is forced to close down. If something is busted, it is broken or damaged.

words.tr: v. 夸大，言过其实； adj. 使扩大（exaggerate 的现在分词）；
words.ex: He is exaggerating his achievements to impress others.
words.ex_cn: 他正在夸大自己的成就以给别人留下印象。
words.en: If you exaggerate, you indicate that something is, for example, worse or more important than it really is.

words.ex: He has an obsessive need to clean everything.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种强迫性的需求，要把一切都打扫干净。
words.en: If someone's behaviour is obsessive, they cannot stop doing a particular thing or behaving in a particular way.

words.tr: n. 摊牌；最后一决胜负；决战
words.ex: The showdown between the two leaders is scheduled for next week.
words.ex_cn: 两位领导人的摊牌定于下周举行。
words.en: A showdown is a decisive confrontation or test of strength or will.

words.tr: adj. 最凶猛的，最激烈的
words.ex: The lion is the fiercest animal in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是丛林中最凶猛的动物。
words.en: Superlative form of fierce, meaning the most intense, aggressive, or severe.

words.ex: He felt miserable after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到很悲惨。
words.en: If you are miserable, you are very unhappy.

words.ex: It was an auspicious day for their wedding.
words.ex_cn: 那天是他们婚礼的吉日。
words.en: If you describe something as auspicious, you mean that it is a sign of future success.

words.ex: He adjusted the pin on his suit's lapel.
words.ex_cn: 他调整了西装翻领上的别针。
words.en: The part on each side of a coat or jacket immediately below the collar which is folded back on either side of the front opening.

words.tr: n. 水族馆；水族箱；养鱼缸；
words.ex: We visited the aquarium to see the fish.
words.ex_cn: 我们去水族馆看鱼。
words.en: A tank or building in which fish and other water creatures and plants are kept.

words.ex: He found a clam on the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩上发现了一只蛤。
words.en: A clam is a type of shellfish with a shell in two parts that can open and close. Clams can be eaten as food.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of clam chowder for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一碗蛤蜊浓汤。
words.en: A soup or stew, especially one made with seafood, such as clams or fish.

words.tr: n. 皮船；爱斯基摩小艇；
words.ex: He paddled his kayak down the river.
words.ex_cn: 他划着皮船顺流而下。
words.en: A kayak is a small, narrow boat which is propelled by means of a double-bladed paddle.

words.ex: He painstakingly checked every answer before submitting the test.
words.ex_cn: 他在提交试卷前极其仔细地检查了每一个答案。
words.en: With great care and thoroughness.

words.ex: The realtor showed us the new house.
words.ex_cn: 房地产经纪人带我们看了那套新房。
words.en: A realtor is a person whose job is to sell houses, buildings, and land for other people.

words.ex: The city has a curfew at 10 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 这座城市晚上10点实行宵禁。
words.en: A curfew is an order given by the authorities that people must stay indoors between certain hours, typically at night.

words.tr: n. （尤指贵重物品的）盗窃，抢劫; v. （尤指贵重物品的）盗窃，抢劫; n. （Heist）（美...
words.ex: The thieves planned a big heist at the bank.
words.ex_cn: 窃贼计划对银行实施一次大规模抢劫。
words.en: A heist is a robbery or burglary, especially one that is carefully planned and involves stealing large amounts of money or valuable items.

words.ex: She wore a beautiful jewel on her finger.
words.ex_cn: 她手指上戴着一颗漂亮的珠宝。
words.en: A jewel is a precious stone that is used to decorate valuable objects such as rings or necklaces.

words.ex: The children's rumpus could be heard from the street.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们的喧闹声从街上都能听到。
words.en: A noisy or tumultuous disturbance.

words.ex: The wires are intricately connected.
words.ex_cn: 这些电线复杂地连接在一起。
words.en: In a manner that is very complicated or detailed.

words.tr: n. （墨西哥人食用的）烤干酪辣味玉米片
words.ex: He eats a nacho with cheese.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一个配奶酪的玉米片。
words.en: A nacho is a piece of tortilla topped with cheese and other ingredients, often served as a snack.

words.ex: The glorious sunset lit up the whole sky.
words.ex_cn: 辉煌的日落染红了整个天空。
words.en: Something that is glorious is very beautiful and impressive.

words.ex: The child gave a naive smile when he believed the story.
words.ex_cn: 当孩子相信这个故事时，他露出了天真的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone as naïve, you think they lack experience and so expect things to be easy or people to be honest or kind.

words.ex: He is a legendary basketball player.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位传奇的篮球运动员。
words.en: Something or someone that is legendary is very famous and is often talked about in a way that suggests they are almost mythical.

words.tr: n. 海（或湖）滨线；海（或湖）岸线
words.ex: The children played near the shoreline.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在岸边玩耍。
words.en: The line where a body of water meets the land.

words.tr: n. 摧毁；拆毁；拆除；大败；
words.ex: The demolition of the old building started last week.
words.ex_cn: 那座旧楼的拆除上周开始了。
words.en: The act of demolishing something, especially a building.

words.tr: n. 分户出售公寓大厦（等于 condominium）; n. （Condo）人名；（意）孔多
words.ex: He bought a condo near the beach.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一套靠近海滩的公寓。
words.en: A condo is an apartment in a building with several apartments, each of which is owned by the people living in it.

words.tr: n. 月球探测器；对月球发射
words.ex: The moonshot landed on the moon in 1969.
words.ex_cn: 这个月球探测器于1969年登陆月球。
words.en: A moonshot is an ambitious, exploratory and ground-breaking project undertaken without any expectation of near-term profitability or benefit and also, perhaps, without a full investigation of potential risks and benefits.

words.tr: v. 确定；定案；最终确定
words.ex: He will finalize the plan tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 他明天会最终确定这个计划。
words.en: To finalize something means to complete all the arrangements for it, especially by discussing it with other people involved.

words.ex: The roller coaster gave her a thrill.
words.ex_cn: 过山车让她感到兴奋。
words.en: A thrill is a sudden feeling of great excitement, pleasure, or fear.

words.ex: The rebel fought against the king's rules.
words.ex_cn: 这位叛逆者反抗国王的法令。
words.en: A rebel is a person who opposes or fights against people in authority.

chapters.name: 电影Love is in the air爱在云霄

words.tr: adj. 拨弄的；转动的；反复摆弄的（指手指或小物件来回转动）
words.ex: He is twiddling his thumbs while waiting.
words.ex_cn: 他正在等待时摆弄手指。
words.en: The act of fidgeting or playing with something absent-mindedly.

words.tr: n. 板条箱；箱子；篓；破旧的飞机或汽车；
words.ex: The apples were packed in a wooden crate.
words.ex_cn: 苹果被装在一个木板条箱里。
words.en: A crate is a large box used for transporting or storing goods.

words.ex: He was caught bribing the officer with money.
words.ex_cn: 他因用钱贿赂官员而被抓获。
words.en: The act of offering, giving, receiving, or soliciting something of value for the purpose of influencing the action of an official in the discharge of his or her public or legal duties.

words.ex: The company's consolidation improved its market position.
words.ex_cn: 公司的巩固增强了其市场地位。
words.en: The act of combining two or more things into a single more effective or coherent whole.

words.tr: adj. 可抢救的；可打捞的；可挽救的
words.ex: The old furniture was still salvageable.
words.ex_cn: 旧家具仍然是可以利用的。
words.en: If something is salvageable, it can be saved or recovered after being damaged or lost.

words.tr: adj. 航空的；航空学的；飞机驾驶员的（等于 aeronautic）
words.ex: He designs aeronautical systems for airplanes.
words.ex_cn: 他为飞机设计航空系统。
words.en: Relating to the science or practice of building or flying aircraft.

words.tr: n. 废弃物（树枝、碎石等）；
words.ex: The workers cleared the brash from the construction site.
words.ex_cn: 工人们清除了建筑工地上的废弃物。
words.en: If you describe someone or their behavior as brash, you disapprove of them because you think that they are too confident and aggressive.

words.ex: His calm temperament helps him stay peaceful in stress.
words.ex_cn: 他平静的性情让他在压力下保持平和。
words.en: Your temperament is your basic nature, especially as it is shown in the way that you react to situations or to other people.

words.ex: He shows diligence in doing his homework every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天认真完成作业。
words.en: Conscientiousness in paying proper attention to a task; giving the degree of care required in a given situation.

words.tr: adv. 反常地；见异思迁地
words.ex: He is freakishly tall for his age.
words.ex_cn: 他相对于年龄来说高得不可思议。
words.en: In a way that is remarkably unusual or strange, often to an unsettling degree.

words.ex: He used a euphemism to say he lost his job.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个委婉语来表示他失业了。
words.en: A euphemism is a polite word or expression that is used to refer to things which people may find upsetting or embarrassing to talk about.

words.ex: He did it out of spite.
words.ex_cn: 他出于恶意做了这件事。
words.en: If you do something out of spite, you do it because you want to hurt or upset someone.

words.tr:
n. 单据；摘要；诉讼事件表
v. 在...上附加摘要
words.ex: The clerk filed the docket for the upcoming trial.
words.ex_cn: 书记员为即将到来的审判归档了摘要。
words.en: A docket is a list of cases to be heard by a court or a summary of the contents of a document.

words.tr:
adj. 无准备的；即兴的；即席的
adv. 无准备地；即兴地；即席地
words.ex: He gave an impromptu speech at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上做了一次即兴演讲。
words.en: An impromptu action is one that you do without planning or organizing it in advance.

words.ex: The scenic lake attracted many tourists.
words.ex_cn: 风景优美的湖泊吸引了许多游客。
words.en: Relating to or resembling scenery; picturesque.

words.tr: adj.  活泼的；明快的；时髦的；没好气的
words.ex: He gave a snappy reply to the question.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个问题给出了干脆利落的回答。
words.en: If someone is snappy, they speak to people in a sharp, unfriendly way.

words.ex: He called his brother a wanker after losing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛输了后称他的兄弟为蠢货。
words.en: A wanker is a term of abuse or contempt for someone considered to be foolish or annoying, or it can refer to someone who masturbates.

words.tr: v. 扔；抛；丢掷；放弃；离职
words.ex: He chucked the old book into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把那本旧书扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: To throw something carelessly or casually; to give up or stop doing something.

words.ex: The village has a quaint old church.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄有一座古色古香的古老教堂。
words.en: Something that is quaint is attractive because it is unusual and old-fashioned.

words.tr:
adj. 乡村的；纯朴的；土气的
n. 乡下人；乡巴佬
words.ex: They live in a rustic cabin near the woods.
words.ex_cn: 他们住在森林附近的一间乡村小屋里。
words.en: Rustic is used to describe things that are typical of the countryside rather than the town, or things that are simple and old-fashioned in a way that is considered typical of the countryside.

words.ex: The city is predominantly populated by young people.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市主要由年轻人居住。
words.en: If something is predominantly true, it is true to a much greater extent than it is false.

words.tr: adj. 信任的；信赖的；依靠的
words.ex: He is reliant on his friend for help.
words.ex_cn: 他信任朋友来帮助他。
words.en: A person or thing that is reliant on someone or something else depends on them for support or help.

words.ex: The government subsidize small businesses to help them grow.
words.ex_cn: 政府资助小企业以帮助它们发展。
words.en: To subsidize something means to pay part of the cost of it, usually as a way of helping people or organizations that cannot afford to pay the full cost themselves.

words.ex: The magician pulled a rabbit from a hat.
words.ex_cn: 魔术师从帽子里变出了一只兔子。
words.en: A magician is a person who performs magic tricks to entertain people, often as part of a show.

words.ex: He wore a straitjacket in the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院里穿了约束衣。
words.en: A straitjacket is a garment shaped like a jacket with long sleeves which can be tied behind the wearer's back to restrain them.

words.ex: The table is made of sturdy wood.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是用坚固的木头做的。
words.en: Someone or something that is sturdy looks strong and is unlikely to be easily injured or damaged.

words.ex: The weather today is nasty and rainy.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气令人不愉快，又阴又雨。
words.en: If you describe something as nasty, you mean it is very unpleasant, unattractive, or unkind.

words.tr: int. 你好（非正式问候语）
words.ex: Howdy, friend!
words.ex_cn: 你好啊，朋友！
words.en: Howdy is an informal greeting, a contraction of 'how do you do', used especially in the southern United States.

words.tr: adj. 紧握的；顽强的；坚决的；强的（记忆力）
words.ex: The child held the toy with tenacious hands.
words.ex_cn: 孩子用紧握的手抓住玩具。
words.en: If you describe someone as tenacious, you are admiring their determination to do something and their refusal to stop trying even when it is difficult.

words.tr:
n. 蘸有柏油的碎石；柏油碎石地面；停机坪
v. 以柏油碎石铺筑（路面）
words.ex: The plane taxied down the tarmac before coming to a stop.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在柏油碎石路面上滑行，然后停了下来。
words.en: A tarmac is a road surface or airport runway made of tar and broken stones.

words.tr: adj. 使人晕眩的；头晕的；轻浮的
words.ex: She felt giddy after spinning around.
words.ex_cn: 她转圈后感到头晕目眩。
words.en: If you feel giddy, you feel unsteady and think that you are about to fall over, usually because you are not well or because you are excited or frightened.

words.tr:
n. 回归线；热带
adj. 热带的
words.ex: The Tropic of Cancer is north of the equator.
words.ex_cn: 北回归线在赤道以北。
words.en: The tropics are the region of the Earth surrounding the Equator. They are delimited in latitude by the Tropic of Cancer in the Northern Hemisphere at 23°26′10.0″ (or 23.4361°) N and the Tropic of Capricorn in the Southern Hemisphere at 23°26′10.0″ (or 23.4361°) S; these latitudes correspond to the axial tilt of the Earth.

words.ex: She is the epitome of kindness.
words.ex_cn: 她是善良的典型。
words.en: A person or thing that is a perfect example of a particular quality or type.

words.tr: v. 威胁；“threaten”的现在分词； adj. 威胁的；
words.ex: He was threatening the neighbor with a stick.
words.ex_cn: 他用棍子威胁邻居。
words.en: If someone's behavior or actions are threatening, they make you feel that they might harm you.

words.ex: He uses a spreadsheet to count his money.
words.ex_cn: 他用电子表格来计算他的钱。
words.en: A spreadsheet is a computer program that is used for displaying and dealing with numbers. It shows numbers in rows and columns, and it is used especially for doing financial calculations and for creating graphs.

words.tr:
n. （葡萄酒）制造年份；
adj. 古老的；
words.ex: This wine is from a vintage of 2015.
words.ex_cn: 这款葡萄酒产自2015年的酿造年份。
words.en: Vintage is used to describe something that is not just old, but is also of high quality and typical of the best of its kind.

words.tr: n. 螺丝刀；改锥；螺丝起子；伏特加橙汁鸡尾酒
words.ex: He used a screwdriver to tighten the loose screws.
words.ex_cn: 他用螺丝刀拧紧了松动的螺丝。
words.en: A screwdriver is a tool that is used for turning screws. It has a handle and a long metal part that fits into the top of the screw.

words.ex: He put his clothes in the wardrobe.
words.ex_cn: 他把衣服放进衣橱里。
words.en: A wardrobe is a tall cupboard or cabinet in which you can hang your clothes.

words.tr:
v. 生气；用烟熏；冒烟
n. 烟雾；烟气；愤怒；烦恼
words.ex: He fumed when he saw the mess.
words.ex_cn: 他看到一团糟时生气了。
words.en: Fume refers to gas, smoke, or vapor that smells strongly or is dangerous to inhale. It can also mean to emit gas, smoke, or vapor, or to be very angry.

words.ex: The dog was thrashing in the water.
words.ex_cn: 狗在水里猛烈挣扎。
words.en: A thrashing is a severe beating or defeat.

words.ex: He plays rugby every Saturday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个星期六打橄榄球。
words.en: Rugby is a sport played by two teams of 15 players each, using an oval ball that players kick, pass, or carry in order to score points by grounding the ball behind the opponent's goal line or kicking it between the goalposts.

words.tr:
n. 游园会；庆祝；盛大节日
v. 宴请；招待
words.ex: The town held a fete to raise money for the school.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇举办了一场集市来为学校筹款。
words.en: A fete is an outdoor event with stalls, games, and entertainments, often organized to raise money for a particular purpose.

words.tr: n. 土音（尤指爱尔兰人讲英语时的土腔），（旧时爱尔兰人穿的）粗革皮鞋
words.ex: He speaks with a thick brogue.
words.ex_cn: 他说话带着浓重的口音。
words.en: A brogue is a type of shoe, traditionally a low-heeled, leather shoe with decorative perforations. It can also refer to a strong accent, especially an Irish one.

words.tr: adj. 可怜的；悲哀的；差劲的；令人生厌的
words.ex: The little dog looked pathetic in the rain.
words.ex_cn: 那只小狗在雨中看起来很可怜。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as pathetic, you mean that they are sad and weak or inadequate, and you feel contempt or pity for them.

words.ex: The boss gave a positive appraisal of his work.
words.ex_cn: 老板对他的工作给予了积极的评估。
words.en: An appraisal is a judgement or assessment of the value, nature, or quality of something or someone.

words.tr: adj. 彻底的；完全的；详尽的；
words.ex: He did a thorough cleaning of the house.
words.ex_cn: 他对房子进行了彻底的清洁。
words.en: A thorough action or activity is one that is done very carefully and in a detailed way so that nothing is forgotten.

words.tr: adj. 匆忙的；草率的；急躁的
words.ex: He made a hasty decision and regretted it.
words.ex_cn: 他做了一个仓促的决定，后来后悔了。
words.en: If you describe a person or their behavior as hasty, you mean that they are acting too quickly, without thinking carefully, often with unwanted results.

words.ex: He has a sweaty forehead after running.
words.ex_cn: 他跑步后额头满是汗。
words.en: If something is sweaty, it is covered in sweat or causes sweat.

words.ex: He is greedy and always wants more candy.
words.ex_cn: 他很贪婪，总是想要更多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe someone as greedy, you mean that they want to have more of something such as food or money than is necessary or fair.

words.tr:
n. 私生子；浑蛋
adj. 私生的
words.ex: He called his brother a bastard during the fight.
words.ex_cn: 他在争吵时称他哥哥是杂种。
words.en: A bastard is a child whose parents were not married to each other at the time of its birth. This term can also be used as an insult to describe someone who is considered to be despicable or unpleasant.

chapters.name: 电影A Perfect Pairing完美搭配

words.ex: He picked a red raspberry from the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他从花园里摘了一颗红树莓。
words.en: A raspberry is a small, soft red fruit that grows on bushes. It is also used to denote a sound made to express derision or contempt.

words.ex: He wore a burgundy sweater to the party.
words.ex_cn: 他参加派对时穿了一件酒红色的毛衣。
words.en: Burgundy is a region in eastern France, known for its wine.

words.ex: We visited a old chateau in the French countryside.
words.ex_cn: 我们参观了法国乡村的一座古老城堡。
words.en: A chateau is a large French country house or castle, often giving its name to wine made in its neighbourhood.

words.tr: n. 牛肝菌（porcino 的变形）; n. （Porcini）人名；（意）波尔奇尼
words.ex: He cooked porcini mushrooms with garlic.
words.ex_cn: 他用大蒜烹煮了牛肝菌。
words.en: A prized edible mushroom with a brown, nutty-flavoured cap and a thick, bulbous stem, found in woodlands.

words.ex: He bought a new mirror because of his vanity.
words.ex_cn: 他因为虚荣心买了一面新镜子。
words.en: The quality of being vain; excessive pride in or admiration of one's own appearance or achievements.

words.ex: He wore a laurel crown on his head.
words.ex_cn: 他头上戴着月桂花环。
words.en: A laurel is a type of shrub or tree, specifically the bay tree, whose leaves are used in cooking and as a symbol of victory or honor.

words.ex: The child is whining because he wants candy.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子因为想要糖果而哭闹。
words.en: To complain in a feeble or petulant way.

words.ex: He works in a vineyard near the hills.
words.ex_cn: 他在山边的一个葡萄园工作。
words.en: A vineyard is a plantation of grape-bearing vines, grown mainly for winemaking, but also raisins, table grapes and non-alcoholic grape juice.

words.tr:
n. 奖品；裁定；
v. 授予；
words.ex: He received an award for best student.
words.ex_cn: 他获得了最佳学生奖。
words.en: An award is a prize or other mark of recognition given in honor of an achievement.

words.tr:
adj. 与安息日有关的
n. （大学教师每七年一次的）公休假
words.ex: He took a sabbatical from university to write a book.
words.ex_cn: 他从大学请假一年去写书。
words.en: A sabbatical is a period of paid leave granted to a university teacher or other worker for study or travel, traditionally one year for every seven years worked.

words.tr: n. 运动裤；汗衫裤（通常指宽松舒适的运动休闲裤）
words.ex: He wears sweatpants to exercise at home.
words.ex_cn: 他穿运动裤在家锻炼。
words.en: Loose-fitting trousers with an elastic waistband, worn for comfort or exercise.

words.tr:
n. 抓痕；刮伤；
v. 抓搔；刮；
words.ex: The cat left a scratch on the door.
words.ex_cn: 猫在门上抓出了一道抓痕。
words.en: If you scratch something, you rub your fingernails or claws against it, often because it is itchy or irritating.

words.tr: n. 连接；（非正式）性关系；（美）临时的恋爱关系
words.ex: He got a hookup with his friend for the party.
words.ex_cn: 他和朋友约好一起去参加派对。
words.en: An informal meeting or arrangement, often for a casual romantic or sexual encounter.

words.ex: The picture is fuzzy and hard to see.
words.ex_cn: 这张图片很模糊，看不清楚。
words.en: Something that is fuzzy is unclear or indistinct, often because it is out of focus or because it is covered with a soft, fluffy material.

words.tr: n. 势利小人；谄上欺下的人；恃才傲物的人
words.ex: He acts like a snob because he only likes expensive things.
words.ex_cn: 他只喜欢昂贵的东西，所以表现得像个势利小人。
words.en: A snob is someone who thinks they are better than other people because they are more intelligent, more cultured, or of a higher social class.

words.ex: He drinks a margarita at the beach party.
words.ex_cn: 他在海滩派对上喝一杯玛格丽特。
words.en: A margarita is a cocktail consisting of tequila, lime juice, and Cointreau or triple sec.

words.tr: n. 沿岸贸易船；杯托，小托盘；雪橇
words.ex: The coaster carries goods along the coast.
words.ex_cn: 这艘沿岸贸易船沿着海岸运输货物。
words.en: A coaster is a small mat that you put a glass or cup on to protect a surface from heat or moisture.

words.tr:
adj. 精心制作的；详尽的；
v. 精心制作；详尽阐述；
words.ex: She wore an elaborate dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件精心制作的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: To elaborate means to add more details to something that has already been said or written, making it more complex or detailed. As an adjective, it describes something that is very complex and detailed.

words.tr:
v. 乱写；乱画；涂鸦
n. 乱画；乱写；涂鸦
words.ex: He doodled on his notebook during class.
words.ex_cn: 他在上课时在笔记本上乱画。
words.en: If you doodle, you draw small, simple pictures or patterns on a piece of paper, often while you are thinking about something else.

words.tr: adj. 乌拉圭的；乌拉圭人的
words.ex: The Uruguayan team won the match.
words.ex_cn: 乌拉圭队赢得了比赛。
words.en: Relating to Uruguay or its people.

words.ex: He enjoys sleuthing around the city to find hidden gems.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢在城市里四处侦探，寻找隐藏的宝藏。
words.en: The act of investigating or detecting, especially in a manner resembling that of a detective.

words.tr: n. 寄宿处； v. “lodge”的现在分词；
words.ex: He found cheap lodging near the train station.
words.ex_cn: 他在火车站附近找到了便宜的寄宿处。
words.en: Lodging refers to a place to live or stay, especially temporarily.

words.tr:
v. 窥探；刺探
n. 打探私事的人；私家侦探
words.ex: He tries to snoop in his neighbor's mailbox.
words.ex_cn: 他试图偷看邻居的邮箱。
words.en: To snoop means to look around a place secretly in order to discover things, especially things that someone does not want you to know.

words.tr: n. 懒汉；不劳而获的人；寄生虫
words.ex: He is a bludger who never works.
words.ex_cn: 他是个从不干活的懒虫。
words.en: In Quidditch, a ball that aggressively tries to knock players off their brooms; also used metaphorically for a persistent nuisance.

words.tr:
n. 埋伏；伏击
v. 埋伏；伏击
words.ex: The soldiers set an ambush at night.
words.ex_cn: 士兵们在夜间设下埋伏。
words.en: An ambush is a surprise attack by people lying in wait in a concealed position.

words.ex: She showed a lot of moxie when she stood up to the bully.
words.ex_cn: n. 当她站出来对抗欺凌者时，她表现出了很大的勇气。
words.en: Moxie is the ability to face difficulty with spirit and courage.

words.tr: n. 澳大利亚和新西兰的年轻牧场工人；牛仔
words.ex: He is working as a jackaroo on a farm in Australia.
words.ex_cn: 他正在澳大利亚的一个农场当见习牧工。
words.en: A male farmhand or jackaroo, especially in Australian usage; a young man working on a station.

words.tr: n. 剪切机; 剪羊毛的人
words.ex: The shearer cuts wool from sheep every spring.
words.ex_cn: 剪毛工每年春天给羊剪毛。
words.en: A shearer is a person who shears sheep or a machine that is used for shearing sheep.

words.ex: The farmer feeds his livestock every morning.
words.ex_cn: 农夫每天早上喂他的家畜。
words.en: Livestock are animals such as cattle and sheep which are kept on a farm.

words.ex: She is happy about her pregnancy.
words.ex_cn: 她对她的妊娠感到开心。
words.en: The condition of having a developing embryo or fetus in the body, especially in the uterus.

words.ex: He will mend his broken shoe.
words.ex_cn: 他将修补他破掉的鞋子。
words.en: If you mend something that is broken or damaged, you repair it, so that it works properly or so that it looks like new again.

words.ex: The dog jumped over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 狗跳过了栅栏。
words.en: A fence is a barrier between two areas of land, made of wood or wire supported by posts. If you fence an area of land, you surround it with a fence.

words.tr: n. 小袋；囊状袋；育儿袋；
words.ex: The kangaroo carries its baby in a pouch.
words.ex_cn: 袋鼠把幼崽放在小袋里。
words.en: A pouch is a small, flexible bag, typically made of leather or fabric, used for carrying small items.

words.ex: The radiator is hot in the winter.
words.ex_cn: 冬天时，散热器是热的。
words.en: A radiator is a device for heating a room or building, consisting of a series of pipes through which hot water or steam is circulated. It can also refer to a device for cooling an engine or other mechanism, typically consisting of a bank of thin tubes with fins attached, through which coolant flows.

words.tr:
n. 半身像；胸部；搜捕
v. 打碎；搜捕
adj. 破产的；打碎的
words.ex: The museum has a marble bust of the ancient king.
words.ex_cn: 博物馆里有一座古代国王的大理石半身像。
words.en: A bust is a sculpture of a person's head, shoulders, and chest. As a verb, to bust means to break something, to arrest someone, or to go bankrupt.

words.ex: As a newbie, she was still learning the ropes of the job.
words.ex_cn: 作为一名新手，她还在学习工作的基本要领。
words.en: A newbie is someone who is new to an activity, especially computing or the internet.

words.ex: The judge showed mercy and let him go free.
words.ex_cn: 法官仁慈地让他自由了。
words.en: If someone in authority shows mercy, they choose not to harm someone they have power over, or they forgive someone they have the right to punish.

words.ex: Let's meet in the arvo for coffee.
words.ex_cn: 我们下午见面喝咖啡吧。
words.en: Arvo is an informal Australian and New Zealand term for the afternoon.

words.ex: He left a heap of clothes on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把一堆衣服扔在地上。
words.en: A heap of things is a pile of them, especially a pile arranged in a rather untidy way.

words.tr:
adj. 无准备的；即兴的；即席的
adv. 无准备地；即兴地；即席地
words.ex: He gave an impromptu speech at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上做了一次即兴演讲。
words.en: An impromptu action is one that you do without planning or organizing it in advance.

words.tr:
n. 谜语；费解的事
v. 解谜；出谜；使布满窟窿；打洞
words.ex: He told me a riddle and I solved it.
words.ex_cn: 他给我出了一道谜语，我解出来了。
words.en: A riddle is a question or statement that is deliberately very confusing and has a clever or amusing answer.

words.tr: n. 恶作剧；开玩笑；戏谑
words.ex: He played a prank on his friend with a fake spider.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个假蜘蛛捉弄了他的朋友。
words.en: A prank is a trick or practical joke that is played on someone, often to make them look foolish or to amuse others.

words.tr: n. 欺侮新人的行为；戏弄
words.ex: The fraternity was punished for hazing new members.
words.ex_cn: 该兄弟会因对新成员进行恶作剧式折磨而受到惩罚。
words.en: Hazing refers to the practice of rituals, challenges, and other activities involving harassment, abuse or humiliation used as a way of initiating a person into a group.

words.tr: n. 赤霞珠（一种用于酿酒的葡萄品种）
words.ex: This wine is made from cabernet grapes.
words.ex_cn: n. 这瓶酒是用赤霞珠葡萄酿造的。
words.en: A type of grape used in making wine, known for its deep color and robust flavor.

words.ex: The sommelier recommended a red wine with dinner.
words.ex_cn: 酒侍推荐了一款红葡萄酒配晚餐。
words.en: A trained professional who advises on and serves wine, typically in a restaurant or hotel setting.

words.tr: n. （美）吐痰；（俚）唾沫弹（指用唾液制成的小球投掷）
words.ex: The pitcher was banned for throwing a spitball.
words.ex_cn: 这名投手因投掷口水球而被禁赛。
words.en: To discuss or propose ideas informally and tentatively, without commitment.

words.tr: n. （毕业典礼上）致告别辞的最优秀毕业生
words.ex: He is the valedictorian of his graduating class.
words.ex_cn: 他是他毕业班级的优秀学生。
words.en: A valedictorian is the student who has the highest grades in a graduating class and who gives a speech at the graduation ceremony.

words.tr: n. 厕所（英式英语中常用，尤指户外或简陋的厕所）
words.ex: He went to the dunny to use the toilet.
words.ex_cn: 他去厕所上厕所了。
words.en: A toilet, especially one in an outdoor or informal setting (Australian and New Zealand informal).

words.tr: adj. 潮湿而有异味的；发霉的；肮脏的
words.ex: The kitchen was scungy after the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对之后，厨房很脏乱。
words.en: Unpleasantly dirty, grimy, or shabby (Australian informal).

words.tr: n. （非标准拼写）可能指代某种特定名称或品牌，目前无明确通用释义
words.ex: She is studying jillaro in college.
words.ex_cn: 她在大学里学习jillaro。
words.en: A female farmhand or jillaroo, especially in Australian usage; a young woman working on a station.

words.ex: He will repurpose old boxes into storage bins.
words.ex_cn: 他将把旧盒子改造成储物箱。
words.en: To adapt or reuse something for a new purpose, often to extend its usefulness or reduce waste.

words.ex: Farmers spread manure on the fields to help crops grow.
words.ex_cn: 农民把肥料撒在田里以帮助庄稼生长。
words.en: Manure is organic matter used as fertilizer in agriculture.

words.ex: He uses fertilizer to help his plants grow.
words.ex_cn: 他用肥料帮助植物生长。
words.en: A substance that is added to soil to improve the growth of plants.

words.tr:
n. 铲；铁锹
v. 铲；铲起
words.ex: He uses a shovel to dig the garden.
words.ex_cn: 他用铲子挖花园。
words.en: A shovel is a tool with a long handle and a broad blade or scoop, used for moving material such as earth, snow, or coal.

words.tr: n. 推广者，延辗机; 横档; 吊箱架; 撒料机
words.ex: The farmer uses a spreader to scatter fertilizer on the field.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用撒肥机在田地上撒化肥。
words.en: A device used to spread something, such as a tool for applying fertilizer, a machine for spreading asphalt, or a utensil for spreading butter on bread.

words.tr: n. 死记硬背；机械的做法；生搬硬套
words.ex: He learned the poem by rote.
words.ex_cn: 他通过死记硬背学会了这首诗。
words.en: Rote is the process of learning something by repeating it many times without thinking about it or understanding it.

words.tr: n. 烈性子的人；脾气暴躁的人
words.ex: She's a real spitfire when she gets angry.
words.ex_cn: 她生气时真是个烈性子的人。
words.en: A spitfire is a person, especially a woman or girl, who is easily angered or has a fiery temper.

words.tr:
n. 动物的粪便
v. 施粪肥于
words.ex: The cow left dung on the grass.
words.ex_cn: 牛在草地上留下了粪便。
words.en: Dung is the excrement of animals, used as manure.

words.ex: The clown amuses the children with funny tricks.
words.ex_cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏娱乐孩子们。
words.en: If something amuses you, it makes you want to laugh or smile.

words.ex: They eat at an upscale restaurant every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他们每周末都在一家高档餐厅吃饭。
words.en: If you describe something as upscale, you mean it is of high quality or intended for people who are wealthy.

words.ex: The bird spread its wing to fly.
words.ex_cn: 鸟张开翅膀飞翔。
words.en: One of the two flat parts that stick out from the side of a bird's body and are used for flying.

words.tr: adj. 独自的；单独的；孤寂的；
words.ex: He lives in a solitary house far from the town.
words.ex_cn: 他住在离城镇很远的独自一人的房子里。
words.en: A solitary person or thing is the only one in a place.

words.tr:
n. 粗毛；蓬乱一团
v. 使蓬松；使杂乱
words.ex: The carpet has a thick, shag texture.
words.ex_cn: 这块地毯有着厚厚的粗毛质感。
words.en: Shag refers to a type of rough, coarse hair or a dance style characterized by energetic movements.

words.ex: The children said they saw a ghost in the old house.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们说他们在老房子里看到了一个鬼。
words.en: A ghost is the spirit of a dead person that some people believe they can see or feel.

words.tr: v. 考虑；深思；凝视；思考…的可能性
words.ex: He contemplates quitting his job.
words.ex_cn: 他正在考虑辞去工作。
words.en: If you contemplate an action, you think about whether to do it or not.

words.ex: He is fined for trespassing on private land.
words.ex_cn: 他因擅闯私有土地而被罚款。
words.en: The act of entering someone's land or property without permission.

words.ex: The storm was destructive and broke many houses.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴具有破坏性，摧毁了许多房屋。
words.en: Causing great and irreparable harm or damage.

words.tr: n. 应变方法；变通方法，替代方法；避免计算机程序问题法
words.ex: He found a workaround to fix the broken printer.
words.ex_cn: 他找到了一个解决办法来修理坏掉的打印机。
words.en: A workaround is a method for achieving a task or goal when the usual or planned method is not possible.

words.tr:
v. （使）突然移动；快速投掷；
n. 镖；
words.ex: The cat darted across the room.
words.ex_cn: 猫突然冲过房间。
words.en: A dart is a small, narrow object with a sharp point which can be thrown or shot. It can also mean to move suddenly and quickly in a particular direction.

words.tr: n. 上腭；味觉；审美眼光；嗜好；爱好
words.ex: The roof of the mouth is called the palate.
words.ex_cn: 口腔的顶部被称为上腭。
words.en: The palate refers to the roof of the mouth in humans and other mammals, separating the oral cavity from the nasal cavity. It also refers to a person's ability to distinguish between and appreciate different flavors.

words.tr:
adj. 令人大怒的
v. 激怒；使狂怒；“infuriate”的现在分词
words.ex: The slow internet is infuriating.
words.ex_cn: 网速慢让人气愤。
words.en: If you describe something or someone as infuriating, you mean that they make you extremely angry.

words.ex: The fierce lion chased the deer.
words.ex_cn: 那只凶猛的狮子追赶着鹿。
words.en: A fierce animal or person is very aggressive or angry.

words.ex: The constable stopped the car for speeding.
words.ex_cn: 警察因超速拦下了那辆车。
words.en: A constable is a police officer of the lowest rank, especially in a town or village.

words.ex: They enjoy chitchat during coffee breaks.
words.ex_cn: 他们在咖啡休息时间喜欢闲聊。
words.en: Light, informal conversation about unimportant things.

words.ex: He had a loud hiccup during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间打了个响亮的嗝。
words.en: A hiccup is an involuntary spasm of the diaphragm and respiratory organs, with a sudden closure of the glottis and a characteristic sound.

words.ex: The stockman is responsible for feeding the cattle every morning.
words.ex_cn: 牧场工人每天早上负责喂牛。
words.en: A stockman is a person who looks after livestock on a farm or ranch.

words.ex: He had a bad hangover after drinking too much beer.
words.ex_cn: 他喝太多啤酒后得了严重的宿醉。
words.en: A hangover is the unpleasant physical condition following the consumption of alcohol, characterized by headache and nausea.

words.ex: The hooligan broke a window during the match.
words.ex_cn: 那个流氓在比赛期间砸了一扇窗户。
words.en: A hooligan is a violent young troublemaker, typically one of a gang.

words.ex: The doll is legless and sits on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 这个玩偶没有腿，坐在地板上。
words.en: Having no legs; extremely drunk.

words.ex: He works at a small winery near the hills.
words.ex_cn: 他在山边的一家小酒庄工作。
words.en: A winery is a place where wine is made, often including vineyards where the grapes are grown.

words.tr: n. 待缝补的衣服 v. 修理，修补( mend的现在分词 ); 改[纠]正; 改善[进]; 恢复
words.ex: He is mending his broken shoe.
words.ex_cn: 他正在修补他破掉的鞋子。
words.en: The act of repairing something that is broken or damaged.

words.ex: The farmer uses biodynamic methods to grow vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这位农民使用生物动力法种植蔬菜。
words.en: relating to a system of organic farming that emphasizes the interrelationship of soil, plants, and animals, viewing the farm as a self-sustaining ecosystem.

words.ex: This wine is made from a single varietal grape.
words.ex_cn: 这种葡萄酒是用单一品种的葡萄酿造的。
words.en: Relating to or characteristic of a variety, especially a biological variety or a wine made from a single variety of grape.

words.tr:
v. 补充；与…相辅相成；
n. 补足物；补语；余角；
words.ex: The red scarf complements her blue coat.
words.ex_cn: 这条红围巾补充了她的蓝外套。
words.en: To complement something means to make it complete or perfect by adding something to it.

words.tr:
n. 柑橘类果实；
adj. 柑橘类果实的；
words.ex: He loves eating citrus like oranges and lemons.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢吃柑橘类果实，比如橙子和柠檬。
words.en: Citrus is a genus of flowering trees and shrubs in the rue family, Rutaceae. Plants in the genus produce citrus fruits, including important crops such as oranges, lemons, grapefruits, pomelos, and limes.

words.ex: He drinks vino with dinner every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚餐时喝红酒。
words.en: Informal term for wine, especially red wine.

words.tr: n. 真理；真实（源自拉丁语 'veritas'，意为真理）
words.ex: He told the verita about what happened.
words.ex_cn: 他讲了发生的事情的真相。
words.en: A female farmhand or jillaroo, especially in Australian usage; a young woman working on a station.

words.ex: After the party, he was quite boozy and couldn't walk straight.
words.ex_cn: 派对后，他喝得醉醺醺的，走不直路。
words.en: Relating to, characterized by, or involving the consumption of alcoholic drink, especially to excess.

words.tr: n. 喋喋不休；胡言乱语；adj. 喋喋不休的；胡言乱语的
words.ex: The feverish man was babbling nonsense.
words.ex_cn: 那个发烧的男人在说胡话。
words.en: If someone is babbling, they are talking in a confused or silly way because they are nervous, drunk, or a baby. A babbling sound is a continuous, low, indistinct sound, like the sound of water flowing over stones.

words.ex: He is an aussie who loves surfing.
words.ex_cn: 他是个喜欢冲浪的澳大利亚人。
words.en: An Aussie is a person from Australia.

words.ex: He carried his bedroll on his back during the hiking trip.
words.ex_cn: n. 他在徒步旅行时背着铺盖卷。
words.en: A bedroll is a portable roll of bedding that can be carried on the back, used especially by travelers or soldiers.

words.ex: The teacher showed fairness in grading all students.
words.ex_cn: 老师在给所有学生评分时展现了公平。
words.en: Fairness is the quality of treating people equally or in a way that is right or reasonable.

words.tr: n. （通常指车辆的）盲区；看不见的地方
words.ex: The news blindsided him.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息让他措手不及。
words.en: To surprise someone by attacking from an unexpected direction or angle.

words.ex: His room is messy with clothes everywhere.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间很杂乱，衣服到处都是。
words.en: If you describe something as messy, you mean that it is untidy or dirty.

words.ex: He had an outburst when he heard the news.
words.ex_cn: 他听到这个消息时大发雷霆。
words.en: An outburst is a sudden release of strong emotion, often in a way that is unexpected or uncontrolled.

words.ex: The pedestrian crossed the street at the zebra crossing.
words.ex_cn: 行人在斑马线处过马路。
words.en: A pedestrian is a person who is walking in a city, town, or village, especially along a pavement or in a pedestrian area.

words.tr: v. 感到恐慌；“panic”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He panicked when he lost his wallet.
words.ex_cn: 当他丢了钱包时，他感到恐慌。
words.en: Feeling or showing sudden uncontrollable fear or anxiety.

words.tr: n. 码头工人；甲板水手；杂工
words.ex: He worked as a roustabout on the docks during the summer.
words.ex_cn: n. 夏天时他在码头上当杂工。
words.en: A roustabout is a laborer, especially one employed in a harbor or on a ship, to do unskilled jobs.

words.ex: The small town has a maritime history.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇有着海洋历史。
words.en: Relating to the sea, especially in relation to seaborne trade or naval matters.

chapters.name: 电影：A Family Affair非常家务事

words.tr: v. 先占；使全神贯注；占据…的思想
words.ex: The old man preoccupies the best seat in the park.
words.ex_cn: 这位老人先占了公园里最好的座位。
words.en: If something is preoccupying you, you are thinking about it a lot or it is occupying your attention.

words.ex: The needy family received food from the charity.
words.ex_cn: 这个贫穷的家庭从慈善机构收到了食物。
words.en: Needy people do not have enough food, medicine, or clothing, or adequate houses.

words.ex: He slammed the door furiously.
words.ex_cn: 他愤怒地摔上了门。
words.en: In a manner that is full of anger or energy; violently.

words.ex: The paparazzi took photos of the celebrity at the airport.
words.ex_cn: 狗仔队在机场拍下了这位名人的照片。
words.en: Paparazzi are photographers who follow famous people around in order to take pictures of them that they can sell to newspapers or magazines.

words.ex: He immersed the cloth in water.
words.ex_cn: 他把布浸在水里。
words.en: To immerse something or someone means to put them into a liquid so that they are completely covered by it. It can also mean to involve oneself deeply in a particular activity or interest.

words.tr: n. 重复乐段；一小段讲话
words.ex: He plays a loud riff on his guitar.
words.ex_cn: 他用吉他弹奏一段响亮的旋律。
words.en: A riff is a short, repeated tune in jazz or popular music, or the act of playing such a tune.

words.tr: n. 无能力；不合格；不称职
words.ex: His incompetency caused the project to fail.
words.ex_cn: 他的无能导致项目失败。
words.en: The state or quality of being unskilled or incapable of performing a task effectively.

words.tr:
adj. 偏执狂的；患妄想狂的；过分猜疑的
n. 偏执狂患者；妄想症患者
words.ex: He is paranoid that someone is watching him.
words.ex_cn: 他总觉得有人在监视他。
words.en: If you say that someone is paranoid, you mean that they are extremely suspicious and afraid of other people.

words.ex: He went on an errand to buy milk.
words.ex_cn: 他去买牛奶了。
words.en: An errand is a short journey that you make in order to do a job for someone, for example when you go to a shop to buy something for them.

words.ex: The cheese-maker strained the whey from the curds.
words.ex_cn: 奶酪制造商将乳清从凝乳中分离出来。
words.en: Whey is the watery part of milk that remains after the formation of curds.

words.ex: He eats eggs for protein.
words.ex_cn: 他吃鸡蛋来获取蛋白质。
words.en: Proteins are large, complex molecules that play many critical roles in the body. They are necessary for the structure, function, and regulation of the body's tissues and organs.

words.ex: He is a biochemist who works in a lab.
words.ex_cn: 他是一名在实验室工作的生物化学家。
words.en: A biochemist is a scientist who studies the chemical processes and substances that occur within living organisms.

words.ex: She ate a piece of shortcake for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 她吃了一块短蛋糕作为甜点。
words.en: A sweet or savoury dish made with a shortbread-like base, often topped with fruit or cream.

words.ex: He is a famous playwright who writes plays.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的剧作家，写剧本。
words.en: A playwright is a person who writes plays.

words.ex: He called for help in desperation.
words.ex_cn: 他绝望地呼救。
words.en: Desperation is the feeling that you have when you are in such a bad situation that you are willing to take any risk to change it.

words.tr: n. 图示法；象征手法；肖像学；画像研究
words.ex: The church has old iconography on its walls.
words.ex_cn: 教堂的墙上有着古老的圣像图案。
words.en: Iconography is the study or interpretation of images and symbols, especially in art.

words.ex: The biopic chronicles the life of a famous scientist.
words.ex_cn: 这部传记片记录了一位著名科学家的生平。
words.en: A biopic is a film that tells the story of the life of a real person, often a well-known historical figure or celebrity.

words.ex: He wears a pair of sneakers to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天穿一双运动鞋去学校。
words.en: A sneaker is a type of soft shoe that you wear for sports or as informal wear.

words.ex: The antelope runs fast across the grassland.
words.ex_cn: 羚羊在草原上快速奔跑。
words.en: An antelope is a swift-running deer-like mammal with smooth hair and upward-pointing horns, found chiefly in Africa and Asia.

words.tr: n. 织物；（建筑物的）结构；
words.ex: The dress is made of soft fabric.
words.ex_cn: 这条裙子是由柔软的织物制成的。
words.en: Fabric refers to cloth or other material produced by weaving together cotton, nylon, wool, silk, or other threads. It can also refer to the basic structure of a building or a system.

words.tr: adv. 无限地；无穷地；极大地；
words.ex: The stars are infinitely far away.
words.ex_cn: 星星离得无限远。
words.en: In a way that is without limits or bounds; extremely or immeasurably.

words.ex: He felt disgust when he saw the dirty food.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到脏兮兮的食物时，他感到厌恶。
words.en: A feeling of revulsion or profound disapproval aroused by something unpleasant or offensive.

words.ex: He eats spaghetti for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐吃意大利面。
words.en: Spaghetti is a type of pasta that is long, thin, and solid, originally from Italy.

words.ex: He adds garlic to the soup for flavor.
words.ex_cn: 他往汤里加蒜来提味。
words.en: A strong-smelling pungent-tasting bulb, used as a flavoring in cooking and in herbal medicine.

words.ex: He eats cereal with milk every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃谷类食品配牛奶。
words.en: A cereal is a grass that is cultivated for the edible components of its grain, composed of the endosperm, germ, and bran.

words.ex: He agreed verbally, not in writing.
words.ex_cn: 他口头同意了，但没有书面形式。
words.en: In a way that relates to or is expressed in speech, not in writing or action.

words.tr: adj. 令人震惊的；使大吃一惊的； v. “astound”的现在分词；
words.ex: The magician's trick was astounding.
words.ex_cn: 魔术师的魔术令人震惊。
words.en: If something is astounding, it is so surprising or so impressive that it is difficult to believe.

words.ex: He got in trouble for a silly sexcapade last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他上周末因为一个愚蠢的风流韵事而惹上了麻烦。
words.en: A sexually adventurous or promiscuous escapade, often involving multiple partners.

words.ex: The view from the mountain is marvelous.
words.ex_cn: 从山上看到的景色极好。
words.en: If you describe something as marvelous, you are emphasizing that it is extremely good.

words.tr: n. 约会；幽会；幽会地点
words.ex: They met at a secret tryst in the woods.
words.ex_cn: 他们在树林里一个秘密的地方相会。
words.en: A tryst is a secret meeting between lovers.

words.ex: It is rational to save money for the future.
words.ex_cn: 为未来存钱是合理的。
words.en: Based on or in accordance with reason or logic.

words.ex: He felt remorse after lying to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他在对朋友撒谎后感到后悔。
words.en: Remorse is a strong feeling of sadness and regret about something wrong that you have done.

words.tr: n. 囊地鼠（产自北美的一种地鼠）
words.ex: The gopher digs holes in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 地鼠在院子里挖洞。
words.en: A gopher is a small burrowing rodent native to North and Central America, known for its extensive tunneling activities.

words.ex: He put deodorant on his armpit.
words.ex_cn: 他在腋窝上涂了止汗剂。
words.en: The hollow under the arm at the shoulder.

words.ex: The nutritionist gave her advice on eating healthy.
words.ex_cn: 营养师给了她关于健康饮食的建议。
words.en: A nutritionist is a person who is an expert in the field of nutrition and who advises people on what to eat in order to be healthy.

words.tr: v. 背叛；出卖；泄露；暴露；“betray”的过去式和过去分词
words.ex: She felt betrayed by her closest friend.
words.ex_cn: 她觉得自己被最亲密的朋友出卖了。
words.en: If you betray someone who trusts you, you do something which harms them or helps their enemies, often by not being loyal to them.

words.tr: adj. 忧郁的，闷闷不乐的
words.ex: He looks mopey after losing the game.
words.ex_cn: 他输掉比赛后看起来闷闷不乐。
words.en: If someone is mopey, they are in a low-spirited and listless state, often appearing sad or gloomy.

words.tr: adj. 喜怒无常的；情绪多变的；
words.ex: He is moody and changes his mind often.
words.ex_cn: 他喜怒无常，经常改变主意。
words.en: If you describe someone as moody, you mean that their feelings and behavior change frequently, and in particular that they often become depressed or angry without any warning.

words.tr: adj. 很小的；极小的；微量的；很少的
words.ex: She had only a wee bit of sugar left.
words.ex_cn: 她只剩下一点点糖了。
words.en: Very small; very early.

words.tr: adj. 没有的; adv. 不是；决不; n. （Nary）（美）纳里（人名）
words.ex: Nary a word did he say during the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在会议期间一句话也没说。
words.en: Not one; not any.

words.ex: She puts lotion on her hands after washing them.
words.ex_cn: 她洗手后在手上涂乳液。
words.en: A lotion is a liquid that you use to clean, improve, or protect your skin or hair.

words.ex: He has eczema on his arms.
words.ex_cn: 他的胳膊上有湿疹。
words.en: A condition in which patches of skin become rough and inflamed, with blisters that cause itching and bleeding.

words.tr: adj. 羞辱性的；丢脸的； v. “humiliate”的现在分词；
words.ex: The humiliating comment made him feel small.
words.ex_cn: 那句羞辱性的话让他感到自己很渺小。
words.en: If something is humiliating, it makes you feel ashamed and stupid, often because it involves a loss of respect or dignity in front of other people.

words.tr: adj. 补偿的；弥补的; v. 履行；挽回；补救（redeem 的现在分词形式）
words.ex: His sense of humor was his redeeming quality.
words.ex_cn: 他的幽默感是他的可取之处。
words.en: A redeeming quality or feature in someone or something is one that prevents them from being completely bad or worthless.

words.ex: They kiss under the mistletoe at Christmas.
words.ex_cn: 他们在圣诞节时在槲寄生下接吻。
words.en: A parasitic plant that grows on trees, producing white berries.

words.ex: He felt miserable after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到很悲惨。
words.en: If you are miserable, you are very unhappy.

words.ex: He ate semolina porridge for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了粗粒小麦粥。
words.en: Coarse, granular flour made from durum wheat, used in making pasta, puddings, and as a thickening agent.

words.ex: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
words.ex_cn: 面包和米饭富含碳水化合物。
words.en: A carbohydrate is a substance found in foods such as bread, potatoes, and rice which provides your body with heat and energy and which consists of carbon, hydrogen, and oxygen.

words.ex: He avoids gluten because it makes him sick.
words.ex_cn: 他避免食用麸质，因为它让他生病。
words.en: A protein found in wheat and some other grains; it gives dough its elasticity and helps it rise and keep its shape.

words.tr:
n. 天鹅绒；丝绒
adj. 天鹅绒的
words.ex: The chair has a soft velvet cover.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子有柔软的丝绒坐垫。
words.en: A soft fabric with a thick short pile on one side, used for clothing and upholstery.

words.ex: He bought a pair of suede shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他买了一双绒面革鞋。
words.en: Suede is a type of leather with a napped finish, commonly used for jackets, shoes, and furniture.

words.tr: n. 非洲黄瓜（一种带刺的橙色水果，果肉呈绿色，可食用）
words.ex: He ate a kiwano for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个角瓜。
words.en: A tropical fruit with a spiky orange rind and green, jelly-like flesh, also known as horned melon.

words.ex: The cow has two long horns.
words.ex_cn: 这头牛有两只长角。
words.en: A horn is a pointed projection on the head of various animals, consisting of a core of bone surrounded by a sheath of keratin, or a device for making a loud warning noise.

words.ex: He ate a sweet melon for dessert.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块甜瓜当甜点。
words.en: A melon is a large, juicy fruit with a hard rind, belonging to the gourd family, typically eaten fresh.

words.ex: He was diagnosed with dementia last year.
words.ex_cn: 他去年被诊断出患有痴呆。
words.en: Dementia is a condition characterized by progressive or persistent loss of intellectual functioning, especially memory impairment, often associated with aging.

words.tr: adj. 有角的；有角状物的
words.ex: The horned sheep stood near the fence.
words.ex_cn: 那只有角的羊站在围栏附近。
words.en: Having horns or hornlike projections.

words.ex: He ate an avocado for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 他早餐吃了一个牛油果。
words.en: A green, pear-shaped fruit with a creamy texture and a large seed, often used in salads and guacamole.

words.ex: She buys organic vegetables at the market.
words.ex_cn: 她在市场上买有机蔬菜。
words.en: Relating to or derived from living matter; denoting or characterized by a harmonious relationship between the elements of a whole.

words.ex: He moseyed down the street to the café.
words.ex_cn: 他慢悠悠地沿着街道走向咖啡馆。
words.en: To walk or move in a leisurely or aimless manner.

chapters.name: 电影My Oxford Year 爱在牛津的一年

words.tr: n. [鱼]黑线鳕（鳕的一种）; n. （Haddock）人名；（英）哈多克；（葡）阿多克
words.ex: The fishmonger recommended haddock for tonight's dinner.
words.ex_cn: 鱼贩推荐今晚的晚餐用黑线鳕。
words.en: A haddock is a type of edible fish found in the North Atlantic Ocean.

words.tr: n. 英式香肠的一种，通常为粉红色，用猪肉制成，常用于煮食或烤制
words.ex: He bought a saveloy at the street market.
words.ex_cn: 他在街市上买了一个萨维洛伊香肠。
words.en: A type of seasoned, dried sausage, often eaten cold, popular in the UK and Australia.

words.tr: adj. 软而稠的；糊状的；多愁善感的
words.ex: She made a mushy dessert with bananas and cream.
words.ex_cn: 她做了一道香蕉和奶油的糊状甜点。
words.en: If you describe something as mushy, you mean that it is very soft.

words.tr: adj. 不守规矩的；难控制的；难管束的
words.ex: The unruly child refused to sit quietly.
words.ex_cn: 这个不守规矩的孩子不肯安静地坐着。
words.en: If you describe people, especially children, as unruly, you mean that they behave badly and are difficult to control.

words.tr: n. 陷阱；隐患；想不到的困难；
words.ex: Don't ignore the pitfall of skipping homework.
words.ex_cn: 不要忽视不做作业这个陷阱。
words.en: A pitfall is a likely mistake or problem in a situation.

words.tr: n. （英俚）愚蠢的人；笨蛋（粗俗用语）
words.ex: He is a bellend.
words.ex_cn: 他是个傻瓜。
words.en: A slang term for the head of the penis, often used as an insult.

words.tr:
v. 使湿透；浸透
n. 弄湿；浸液
words.ex: The rain drenched his clothes.
words.ex_cn: 雨把他的衣服淋湿了。
words.en: To drench something or someone means to make them completely wet.

words.tr:
adj. 幻想的；有远见的
n. 空想家；有远见的人
words.ex: He had a visionary idea about flying cars.
words.ex_cn: 他有一个关于飞行汽车的幻想想法。
words.en: A visionary is someone who has strong ideas about how things might be different in the future, especially in a way that leads to changes in society or technology.

words.ex: The alarm clock rang annoyingly early on a Sunday morning.
words.ex_cn: adv. 恼人地
words.en: In a manner that causes irritation or annoyance.

words.ex: He ate a warm crumpet with butter.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一个涂了黄油的热英式松饼。
words.en: A small, round, soft, yeast-leavened bread, typically eaten toasted with butter.

words.tr:
n. 强烈的性欲；强烈的欲望
v. 对…有极强的性欲（或欲望）
words.ex: His lust for power ruined his relationships.
words.ex_cn: 他对权力的强烈欲望毁掉了他的关系。
words.en: Lust is a strong feeling of wanting to have or to do something, especially sexual desire.

words.tr: n. 韵律；节奏；抑扬顿挫
words.ex: The dancer moved with a steady cadence.
words.ex_cn: 舞者以稳定的节奏舞动。
words.en: The rhythm or sequence of sounds or movements in speech, music, dance, etc.

words.ex: He saw his neighbor as a foe.
words.ex_cn: 他把邻居看作敌人。
words.en: A foe is someone who opposes or fights against another; an enemy.

words.tr: n. 两便士（英国旧货币单位）
words.ex: I found tuppence on the street yesterday.
words.ex_cn: n. 我昨天在街上捡到了两便士。
words.en: Tuppence is a term used in Britain to refer to two pence, a small amount of money.

words.tr: adj. 短暂的； v. “fleet”的现在分词；
words.ex: The smile was fleeting.
words.ex_cn: 那个微笑是短暂的。
words.en: If you describe something as fleeting, you mean that it lasts only for a very short time.

words.tr:
n. 尽力；尝试；
v. 尽力；奋力；
words.ex: His endeavor to finish the project took all his energy.
words.ex_cn: 他为完成这个项目付出了全部努力。
words.en: An endeavor is an attempt to do something, especially something new or original.

words.ex: The dog stepped in a puddle.
words.ex_cn: 狗踩进了一个水坑。
words.en: A puddle is a small pool of liquid, especially of rainwater on the ground.

words.tr:
adj. 无准备的；即兴的；即席的
adv. 无准备地；即兴地；即席地
words.ex: He gave an impromptu speech at the party.
words.ex_cn: 他在派对上做了一次即兴演讲。
words.en: An impromptu action is one that you do without planning or organizing it in advance.

words.tr: adj. 令人安心的； v. “reassure”的现在分词；
words.ex: Her smile was reassuring.
words.ex_cn: 她的微笑令人安心。
words.en: If you find someone's words or actions reassuring, they make you feel less worried about something.

words.ex: He had a minor ailment and stayed home from work.
words.ex_cn: 他得了一点小病，没去上班。
words.en: An ailment is a minor illness or health problem.

words.tr: adj. 跖骨的 n. 跖骨
words.ex: The metatarsal bone hurt after he ran too far.
words.ex_cn: 他跑得太远后，跖骨疼了。
words.en: Any of the long bones in the foot between the ankle and the toes.

words.tr:
adj. 颠覆性的；破坏性的
n. 颠覆分子；危险分子
words.ex: The subversive poster tried to break the government's rules.
words.ex_cn: 那张颠覆性的海报试图破坏政府的规则。
words.en: A subversive person or activity is one that is intended to weaken or destroy a political system or government.

words.tr:
n. 寓言；神话传说；无稽之谈
v. 虚构
words.ex: The old man told a fable about a fox and a crow.
words.ex_cn: 老人讲了一个关于狐狸和乌鸦的寓言。
words.en: A fable is a short story that typically features animals as characters and conveys a moral lesson.

words.ex: The suffragette marched for women's right to vote.
words.ex_cn: 这位女权运动者游行争取女性投票权。
words.en: A suffragette was a woman who campaigned for the right to vote in public elections, especially in the early 20th century.

words.ex: He spoke with certitude about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他对于这个答案说话时充满确信。
words.en: A feeling of being certain or convinced about something.

words.ex: It was disgraceful to lie to your teacher.
words.ex_cn: 对老师撒谎是可耻的。
words.en: If you say that something is disgraceful, you are emphasizing that it is very bad or wrong, and that you find it completely unacceptable.

words.tr: adv. 笃信地；虔敬地；认真地
words.ex: He wakes up religiously at 6 a.m.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上六点准时起床。
words.en: If you do something religiously, you do it very regularly because you feel you have to.

words.ex: The mosquito bite makes her skin itchy.
words.ex_cn: 蚊子叮咬让她皮肤发痒。
words.en: If you feel itchy, you have an unpleasant feeling on your skin that makes you want to scratch.

words.tr:
adj. 不锋利的；耿直的
v. 使变钝
words.ex: The knife is blunt and cannot cut paper.
words.ex_cn: 这把刀不锋利，切不动纸。
words.en: If you are blunt, you say exactly what you think without trying to be polite.

words.tr:
adj. 惹人喜爱的
v. 使受喜爱；“endear”的现在分词
words.ex: Her smile is endearing.
words.ex_cn: 她的微笑很可爱。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour as endearing, you mean that it causes you to feel very fond of them.

words.tr: adj. 任性的；故意的；蓄意的
words.ex: The willful child refused to eat his vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 这个任性的孩子拒绝吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you describe actions or attitudes as willful, you are critical of them because they are done or expressed deliberately, especially with the intention of causing harm, or they are stubborn and unreasonable.

words.tr:
v. 撒尿
n. 小便
words.ex: He went outside to take a piss.
words.ex_cn: 他出去小便。
words.en: To urinate; to pass liquid waste from the body.

words.ex: He said it with sarcasm, even though he seemed happy.
words.ex_cn: 他说这话时带着讽刺，尽管他看起来很高兴。
words.en: Sarcasm is a sharp, bitter, or cutting expression or remark; a bitter gibe or taunt.

words.ex: The gargoyles on the church tower looked menacing.
words.ex_cn: 教堂塔楼上的滴水嘴看起来很凶恶。
words.en: A grotesque carved human or animal face or figure projecting from the gutter of a building, typically acting as a spout to carry water clear of a wall.

words.ex: He gave a vicious smile before leaving.
words.ex_cn: 他离开前露出一个恶毒的微笑。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as vicious, you mean that they are violent and cruel, or that they are intended to cause someone great harm or suffering.

words.tr: n. 氪石（虚构的能削弱超人的物质）
words.ex: Superman avoids kryptonite because it weakens him.
words.ex_cn: 超人避开氪石，因为它会削弱他。
words.en: A fictional substance that is the weakness of Superman, capable of draining his strength and powers.

words.ex: The sultan's harem was a place of great intrigue.
words.ex_cn: 苏丹的闺房是一个充满阴谋的地方。
words.en: A harem is the part of a house in some Muslim societies where the women live. It can also refer to the women who live in such a part of a house, especially the wives and concubines of a man.

words.ex: She has a fetish for collecting vintage clothing.
words.ex_cn: 她对收集古董衣服有一种恋物情结。
words.en: A fetish is an object that is believed to have magical powers, especially one that is worshipped by people who believe in magic. In psychology, a fetish is a form of sexual desire in which gratification is linked to an abnormal degree to a particular object, item of clothing, part of the body, etc.

words.ex: The book was dusty on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书在架子上积满了灰尘。
words.en: Covered with or resembling dust; dry and powdery.

words.ex: The doctor explained the disease in layman terms.
words.ex_cn: 医生用通俗易懂的语言解释了这种疾病。
words.en: A layman is a person who does not have specialized or professional knowledge of a subject.

words.ex: He compiles data from many surveys.
words.ex_cn: 他汇编来自许多调查的数据。
words.en: To compile means to collect information from different places and arrange it in a book, report, or list.

words.tr:
adj. 吸引人的；引人入胜的
v. （用铆钉）固定；吸引住；“rivet”的现在分词
words.ex: The movie was riveting from start to finish.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影从头到尾都扣人心弦。
words.en: If you describe something as riveting, you mean that it is extremely interesting and exciting, and that it holds your attention completely.

words.tr:
n. （葡萄酒）制造年份；
adj. 古老的；
words.ex: This wine is from a vintage of 2015.
words.ex_cn: 这款葡萄酒产自2015年的酿造年份。
words.en: Vintage is used to describe something that is not just old, but is also of high quality and typical of the best of its kind.

words.tr: v. (使)脱轨；(使)偏离正轨；破坏计划或进程（derail 的现在分词形式）
words.ex: The storm is derailing the train.
words.ex_cn: 这场风暴使火车脱轨。
words.en: The act of causing a train or other vehicle to leave its tracks, or more broadly, disrupting a plan or process.

words.tr: adj. 最混乱的；最杂乱的（messy 的最高级）
words.ex: His room is the messiest in the house.
words.ex_cn: 他的房间是房子里最乱的。
words.en: Superlative of 'messy'; most untidy, disorganized, or chaotic.

words.tr: n. 流行乐团迷；追星少女
words.ex: The groupie followed the band to every concert.
words.ex_cn: 这个追星族跟着乐队参加每一场演唱会。
words.en: A groupie is someone, especially a young woman, who follows a pop group or other celebrity, especially in the hope of having a sexual relationship with them.

words.tr: n. 烤腌羊肉串；肉串上的肉块
words.ex: He eats a kebab for dinner every Friday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周五吃烤肉串当晚餐。
words.en: A dish consisting of small pieces of meat, fish, or vegetables roasted or grilled on a skewer or spit.

words.tr: v. 使屈辱；使丢脸；使蒙羞
words.ex: He tried to humiliate her in front of the class.
words.ex_cn: 他试图在全班面前羞辱她。
words.en: To humiliate someone means to make them feel ashamed or stupid, especially in front of other people.

words.ex: The truck runs on diesel.
words.ex_cn: 这辆卡车使用柴油运行。
words.en: Diesel is a type of heavy oil used as fuel in diesel engines.

words.tr: adj. 令人作呕的；多病的；不健壮的；憔悴的
words.ex: The sickly sweet smell of the flowers made her nauseous.
words.ex_cn: 花儿那甜得令人作呕的气味让她感到恶心。
words.en: If you describe someone as sickly, you mean that they are often ill or they look as if they are often ill.

words.ex: The glare of the sun made it hard to see.
words.ex_cn: 阳光的刺眼使我看不清。
words.en: If you glare at someone, you look at them with an angry expression on your face. Glare is also a very bright light that is uncomfortable to look at.

words.tr: v. 幸灾乐祸；沾沾自喜；满足地看
words.ex: He gloats when his rival loses the game.
words.ex_cn: 当他的对手输掉比赛时，他幸灾乐祸。
words.en: To gloat means to observe or think about something with triumphant and often malicious satisfaction, gratification, or delight.

words.ex: The monk kept his sacred books in the sanctum.
words.ex_cn: 僧人把他的圣书放在圣所里。
words.en: A sanctum is a private place where you are not disturbed, or a holy place within a temple or church.

words.tr: n. 愚蠢的人；头脑简单的家伙
words.ex: He is a meathead who never thinks before he speaks.
words.ex_cn: 他是个头脑简单的人，说话从不思考。
words.en: Informal, often offensive term for a man who is perceived as physically strong but lacking intelligence.

words.ex: The rower practices every morning.
words.ex_cn: 这位划船运动员每天早上练习。
words.en: A person who rows a boat, especially in a race or as a sport.

words.tr: n. 避难所；庇护所；庇护；
words.ex: The birds found sanctuary in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 这些鸟在森林里找到了避难所。
words.en: A sanctuary is a place where people or animals are protected from danger or trouble.

words.ex: The renovation of the old house took three months.
words.ex_cn: 这所老房子的革新花了三个月。
words.en: The act of improving by renewing and restoring.

words.ex: The king will bestow a medal on the hero.
words.ex_cn: 国王将把奖章授予这位英雄。
words.en: To bestow something on someone means to give or present it to them.

words.tr: n. 参与人（数）；装束；产量；清理
words.ex: The turnout for the election was very high.
words.ex_cn: 这次选举的投票率很高。
words.en: The number of people attending or participating in an event, especially a political meeting or election.

words.ex: He drank a pint of beer after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝了一品脱啤酒。
words.en: A pint is a unit of measurement for liquids. In Britain, it is equal to 568 cubic centimeters or one eighth of a gallon. In the United States, it is equal to 473 cubic centimeters or one eighth of a gallon.

words.tr: n. 并列争球；在扭夺的一堆人；拥挤的人群
words.ex: The rugby players formed a scrum to restart the game.
words.ex_cn: 橄榄球运动员排成并列争球以重新开始比赛。
words.en: In rugby, a scrum is a method of restarting play, involving players packing closely together with their heads down and attempting to gain possession of the ball. In software development, Scrum is a framework for managing and completing complex projects, particularly in software development, emphasizing teamwork, accountability, and iterative progress.

words.ex: The protesters hunkered down in the square overnight.
words.ex_cn: 抗议者们在广场上蹲了一整夜。
words.en: To squat or crouch down low, often to protect oneself or to stay hidden.

words.ex: He measured the yardage of the football field.
words.ex_cn: 他测量了足球场的码数。
words.en: The amount or length of something measured in yards.

words.tr: n. 混乱；错误；糟糕的局面；v. 弄糟；搞乱
words.ex: He bollixed up the simple math problem.
words.ex_cn: 他把简单的数学题搞砸了。
words.en: A vulgar term for testicles; also used as an exclamation of frustration or annoyance.

words.tr: n. （俚语）睾丸；（英）胡说八道，废话
words.ex: He said the plan is bollocks.
words.ex_cn: 他说这个计划一无是处。
words.en: A vulgar term for testicles; also used as an exclamation of frustration or annoyance.

words.tr: adj. 七百周年的；七百年的
words.ex: The town will celebrate its septicentennial next year.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇明年将庆祝其七百周年。
words.en: A humorous or fictional 100th anniversary, often used to describe a centenary that is not officially recognized.

words.tr: adj. 精美的；细腻的；强烈的
words.ex: She wore an exquisite dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一条精美的裙子去参加派对。
words.en: Something that is exquisite is extremely beautiful or pleasant, especially in a delicate or refined way.

words.tr: n. 老处女；未婚女人；老姑娘；
words.ex: The old spinster lived alone in a small house.
words.ex_cn: 那位老处女独自住在一所小房子里。
words.en: A spinster is an unmarried woman, especially an older woman who seems unlikely to marry.

words.tr: n. 过度劳累；过度用力
words.ex: He felt tired because of overexertion.
words.ex_cn: 他因为过度劳累而感到疲惫。
words.en: The act of exerting oneself too much, leading to strain or injury.

words.ex: He is arguably the best player on the team.
words.ex_cn: 可以说他是队里最好的球员。
words.en: Used when stating an opinion that you believe could be proved true.

words.tr: v. 铃声；钟声；鸣响；征收（税）；使感到沉重；使苦恼
words.ex: The bell is tolling for the funeral.
words.ex_cn: 钟声为葬礼而敲响。
words.en: The act of charging a fee for the use of a road, bridge, or other facility.

words.ex: He held her tenderly in his arms.
words.ex_cn: 他温柔地把她抱在怀里。
words.en: In a gentle, loving, or kind manner.

words.tr: n. 慈善；博爱；慈善事业
words.ex: He gives money to charity because of his philanthropy.
words.ex_cn: 他因为慈善精神而捐钱给慈善机构。
words.en: Philanthropy is the act of donating money, goods, time, or effort to support a charitable cause, usually over an extended period of time and in regard to a defined objective.

words.ex: He was imprisoned for stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他因偷窃而被监禁。
words.en: To put someone in prison or keep them as a prisoner.

words.tr:
n. 挂毯；织锦；壁毯；绣帷
v. 用壁毡装饰；罩上绣花罩毯
words.ex: The wall has a colorful tapestry.
words.ex_cn: 墙上有一幅色彩斑斓的挂毯。
words.en: A tapestry is a large piece of heavy cloth on which colored threads are woven to produce a picture, pattern, or design.

words.tr: n. 槌球戏，循环球戏 vi. 击自己的球使其撞打对方的球
words.ex: They play croquet in the park on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他们在周末到公园打槌球。
words.en: A game played on a lawn, in which wooden balls are driven through a series of wickets using mallets.

words.ex: The skater performed a graceful pirouette on the ice.
words.ex_cn: 滑冰者在冰上表演了一个优雅的旋转。
words.en: A skater is someone who skates, especially on ice.

words.ex: He gave me his assurance that the work would be done on time.
words.ex_cn: 他向我保证工作会按时完成。
words.en: If you give someone an assurance that something is true or will happen, you say that it is definitely true or will definitely happen, in order to make them feel less worried.

words.ex: The bloody wound needed immediate care.
words.ex_cn: 那个流血的伤口需要立即治疗。
words.en: Covered or smeared with blood; involving or characterized by bloodshed or cruelty.

words.tr:
n. 哭泣；落泪
v. 流泪；流出
words.ex: Her weep lasted for hours after the news.
words.ex_cn: 听到消息后，她的哭泣持续了数小时。
words.en: To shed tears, especially as an expression of distress or pain.

words.ex: He got pneumonia after a bad cold.
words.ex_cn: 他得了重感冒后患了肺炎。
words.en: Pneumonia is a serious disease which affects your lungs and makes it difficult for you to breathe.

words.ex: The lighthouse stands on a promontory overlooking the sea.
words.ex_cn: 灯塔建在俯瞰大海的岬角上。
words.en: A promontory is a high point of land or rock projecting into a body of water; a headland.

words.tr: n. 骨髓；精华；活力；西葫芦
words.ex: The bone marrow makes blood cells.
words.ex_cn: 骨髓制造血细胞。
words.en: The soft fatty substance in the cavities of bones, in which blood cells are produced; the essence or most vital part of something.

words.ex: He tried to bribe the officer with money.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用钱贿赂官员。
words.en: A bribe is a sum of money or something valuable that one person offers or gives to another in order to persuade them to do something, usually something dishonest.
